topic: 现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析与运用 (Present Perfect vs. Past Simple)
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来学习一对容易混淆的好兄弟——“一般过去时”与“现在完成时”。一般过去时（Past Simple）关注的是“过去某个具体时间发生的事”，动作早已结束，常与 yesterday, two days ago, last year 等明确的过去时间词连用（例：I bought a new bike yesterday.）。而现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）更关心“过去的动作对现在产生的影响”，或者“从过去持续到现在的经历”，常与 already, yet, ever, never, since, for 等词相伴（例：I have lost my key, so I cannot open the door now.）。记住黄金法则：有具体过去时间用过去时，强调与现在的联系或经历用完成时！

questions.question: I cannot open the front door because I ______ my key.
questions.explanation: 钥匙在过去丢了，造成的现在结果是“打不开门”，强调过去的动作对现在的影响，故用现在完成时 have lost。

questions.question: My father ______ to London on business three days ago.
questions.explanation: 句中有明确的过去时间状语 three days ago（三天前），必须使用一般过去时 went。

questions.question:
— Where is Emily? 
— She ______ to the school library to borrow some science books.
questions.explanation: 问句询问“艾米丽在哪里”，说明她人现在不在这里，去了图书馆还没回来，用 has gone to。

questions.question: Mr. Green has lived in this green and quiet town ______ 2018.
questions.explanation: 2018 是一个具体的时间起点，与现在完成时连用时，时间起点前需用介词 since。

questions.question: We have known each other ______ more than six years.
questions.explanation: more than six years 是一段持续的时间长度，与现在完成时连用时，时间段前需用介词 for。

questions.question:
— Have you ______ eaten dragon fruit? 
— No, never. Is it sweet?
questions.explanation: 在现在完成时的疑问句中，表示“曾经”通常用副词 ever。

questions.question: The students haven't finished cleaning the art room ______.
questions.explanation: yet 常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句句末，表示“尚，还”。

questions.question:
— When ______ you ______ this lovely teddy bear? 
— Last Christmas.
questions.explanation: when 引导的特殊疑问句询问具体过去发生的时间，不能用现在完成时，应用一般过去时 did you buy。

questions.question: I am full now. I have ______ had two large bowls of noodles.
questions.explanation: already 常用于肯定句中，放在 have/has 之后或句末，表示“已经”。

questions.question: Look at the mess! Who ______ this window yesterday?
questions.explanation: 句末有具体过去时间 yesterday，谓语动词需用一般过去时 broke。

questions.question:
— Have you ever visited Beijing? 
— Yes, I ______ there with my parents last summer.
questions.explanation: 答句中出现了明确的过去时间 last summer，描述过去的经历动作，需用一般过去时 went。

questions.question: Tina is not hungry at all because she ______ lunch just now.
questions.explanation: just now 意为“刚才”，相当于 a moment ago，通常与一般过去时连用，所以用 had。

questions.question: Lucas ______ this interesting storybook three times so far.
questions.explanation: so far 意为“迄今为止”，是现在完成时的标志性时间状语，主语 Lucas 是第三人称单数，故用 has read。

questions.question: Great news! Our school football team ______ the championship!
questions.explanation: 强调刚刚发生的事情对现在造成的喜讯影响（Great news!），且没有明确过去时间，用现在完成时 has won。

questions.question: Since Uncle Tom arrived in Canada, he ______ many new friends.
questions.explanation: 在“since + 过去时从句”的复合句中，主句通常使用现在完成时，表示从过去某时持续到现在的状态或结果。

questions.question: My elder sister ______ from university in 2024.
questions.explanation: in 2024 是具体的过去年份，动作在过去完成，使用一般过去时 graduated。

questions.question:
— Welcome back, Lisa! How was your trip? 
— Wonderful! I ______ to Shanghai Disneyland.
questions.explanation: 由 Welcome back 可知丽莎已经回来了，have been to 表示“曾经去过某地（现在已返回）”。

questions.question: Grandma ______ her glasses, and she is still looking for them everywhere.
questions.explanation: 后半句说明奶奶现在还在找，说明眼镜丢失的状态一直延续并影响到现在，用现在完成时 has lost。

questions.question: When I was seven years old, I ______ to ride a two-wheel bicycle.
questions.explanation: When I was seven years old 是明确的过去时间从句，描述儿时的过去动作，主句动词用一般过去时 learned。

questions.question:
— Would you like some apple pie? 
— No, thanks. I ______ just ______ my teeth.
questions.explanation: just（刚刚）常夹在助动词 have 与过去分词之间，表示刚做完某事并与现在产生因果联系，故选 have; brushed。

questions.question: Jack ______ ill for a week, but he feels much better today.
questions.explanation: for a week 表示持续了一周的阶段，强调过去持续到现在的状态，与延续性状态动词连用，用 has been。

questions.question: The famous writer ______ ten novels before he passed away in 2021.
questions.explanation: 作家已于2021年去世，其创作行为属于完全结束的过去历史事实，不再对现在发生持续扩展，用一般过去时 wrote。

questions.question: How long ______ you ______ this pet rabbit?
questions.explanation: How long 询问动作或状态持续了多久，需与延续性动词的现在完成时连用，keep 的过去分词是 kept，故选 have; kept。

questions.question: I can't find my pencil case. Did you ______ it this morning?
questions.explanation: 助动词 Did 后面必须接动词原形 see。

questions.question: It is the most exciting movie that I ______ ever ______.
questions.explanation: 在“This/It is the + 最高级 + 名词 + that 从句”句型中，从句通常使用现在完成时表示迄今为止的经历。

questions.question: They ______ in the classroom at 5:00 p.m. yesterday.
questions.explanation: at 5:00 p.m. yesterday 指过去具体的某一个时间点，be动词过去式复数为 were。

questions.question:
— Did you return the book to Peter? 
— Yes, I ______ it to him during recess.
questions.explanation: 问句使用 Did 询问过去的事情，回答指出是在大课间（during recess）发生的一个具体动作，用一般过去时 gave。

questions.question: Neither of my parents ______ to Australia before.
questions.explanation: before（以前）常与现在完成时连用，表示经历；neither of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语动词在正式语法中通常用单数 has been。

questions.question: The rain ______ ten minutes ago, and the sun is shining now.
questions.explanation: ten minutes ago 是明确的过去时间状语，谓语动词必须使用一般过去时 stopped。

questions.question: Up to now, our class ______ over two hundred trees along the riverbank.
questions.explanation: Up to now（到目前为止）是现在完成时的标志词，our class 视为一个整体单数主语，用 has planted。
